title: The Ransom Is Apportioned Among the Misls

blocks.text: This page turns from the treaty itself to the internal arithmetic of the Khalsa commonwealth. Specific misls are named and weighed against one another, including the line tim sayam singh bhai phauj savai, as the chronicler records how claims of manpower and status shaped the division.

The catalogue broadens into a fuller vision of the Sikh order. The ten misls are treated as a sacred-political formation, and the author culminates in the analogy timai panth gur giljai galvayo, linking the confederacy's ordering principle to its providential struggle against Afghan aggression.
Editorially, the page elevates bookkeeping into political theology. Distribution among the misls becomes evidence that the Panth is both an army and a divinely ordered federation.
